_assumptions: Ratios must be iid within each statistic for stated intervals. Interleaving/direction balance/control qualification do not prove this; dense cheap blocks may cluster within macro blocks. Coverage is per phase across 24 statistics, not across all three phases.
_policy: Fixed cost-stratified design: 64 heavy and 512 cheap paired blocks within 64 interleaved macro blocks per phase. The 24 per-statistic exact binomial median intervals use alpha 0.05/24; ranks are [20,45] for R64 and [221,292] for P512, with per-phase joint coverage at least 96.0681% conditional on iid block ratios. All twelve workloads and the 1.10 ratio limit are unchanged. Preserve every prior attempt with its original status; no prior pass is reused. New independent A-A and actual +20% wall-clock-delay controls must qualify before new candidate measurements. No optional stopping, sample extension, best-run selection or outlier deletion.
